rows.row: | w2-agent-core follow-up 46 | D-150's post-merge measurement of agent-core 37 to 43, third attempt, with the same frozen arms (A 567080be, B 38420dad; B's production code re-proved equal to #429's merge). The runner keeps admission receipts out of both Docker streams the frozen harness reads, tested against that exact consumer; it excludes its own ancestors from the suite-process check while their CPU stays foreign; and it launches the driver standalone. 65 runner tests pass. The brief required a full dry A and B leg before any reservation, in at most three rounds, with no reservation for the dry legs themselves. All three rounds ran between 18:36 and 18:40 and stopped on foreign activity: another lane's e2e containers at preflight; another lane's check shell, whose command text matched the suite pattern, 88.4 s into A-dry2 (one of 13 scenarios had passed); and a merge-queue gate process at preflight. B never started. No declaration, reservation or measured leg followed, so both arms have zero pooled legs and no comparison is drawn. The orchestrator scheduled all three activities alongside the dry rounds; agent-core 47 is to run its dry pair under a reservation. Main's ordinary production lab passed all 13 scenarios on 7cfeb4c9, and renewal delivered 1,518 of 1,518 probes. Runner and records only; no production change. 5 commits, 17 owned files. | done (#439) |

| w4-handover follow-up 41 | Cut #435 to #438 at `c359d4a9` (handover 40, agent-core 45, members 19 and devstack 32; no unbriefed PR). `TestHandover_Followup41Claims` (14 subtests) pins the four final roadmap rows and PR excerpts, ten frozen #435 inputs, 101 immutable records and 36 Go test declarations, with seven frozen copies of producer prose for its D-109 token checks; the 34 earlier claims functions stay exact, with four reads moved to frozen #435 bytes. Handover 40's counts verified as main has them. Agent-core 45 recorded with no comparison (zero pooled legs: a parent-shell self-match, then admission text in the frozen harness's combined Docker read) and 46 repeating it. Members 19's same-plan public restoration on both finite-expiry early returns and six more audited sites, with AT02's and AT09's recorded failures unchanged. Devstack 32's exact-code 412 handling (re-read, same key and body, three writes in ten seconds), its eight converted writes and every live invocation, forced 95fb7eab passing 8/8, with the zero-header limit. Decisions stay at 55; only D-150's status changes. Findings register at 105 rows: three updated (D-150's measurement; members 18's grant restoration, answered by #437; F19-02, answered on the publisher side with isolation 20's assembled run pending) and three added (the shared e2e helpers' early returns, to devstack; the AT-owned node-write sites, to their owners; the zero If-Match detail, to the contract and node-API owners), 99 byte-identical. Seven entrypoints point at the cut; no operator or member procedure changed. Isolation 20, agent-core 46 and the orchestrator's review r27 recorded as running. Codex gpt-6-astra. | done (#440) |

| w3-devstack-e2e follow-up 33 | Offline follow-up for devstack 32's audit and members 19's request. The shared publisher's bounded conflict handling is exported on the AT surface as `Stack.WriteNode`, which takes the AT package's own cookie-and-CSRF session and keeps every property of `writeNode`: only exact 412 RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT re-reads, an already-intended re-read ends the command, retries use the fresh ETag with the same key and body, three writes and ten seconds at most, no implicit replay or redirect, and typed receipts an AT record can embed; `NodeFieldsMatch`, `NodePublished` and `NodeRevoked` are exported as read-back predicates, and `writeNode`'s own tests are unchanged. `ReplaceFiniteGrant` now restores what it revoked when a later step fails: it withdraws a replacement whose create response was lost, recreates each original plan and validity once through the public grants API, requires operation success and a live read-back, and returns the original error joined with any recovery failure; the normal path restores nothing, and expired input is still refused before any state is touched. `PrepareNativeRouter1280` undoes completed steps in reverse order when a step fails, with a receipt per inverse, tested at each of its ten steps. An adoption note in RESPONSES routes the AT sites to secops, enrollment, members, usage and updates; members' own fallback restoration stays compatible. No stack, Docker or live run; consumers prove it in their next assembled runs. 6 commits, 26 owned files. Codex gpt-6-astra. | done (#441) |

| w4-at-isolation follow-up 20 | D-098 archive of follow-up 19's root records (113 byte-identical files with SHA-256 pins) committed first. The six driver node writes call devstack 32's shared `writeNode` with exact read-back predicates and per-attempt receipts; an AST audit test fails on any capacity or publication write that bypasses it. Early-abort diagnostics report "unavailable" stages instead of exceptions or borrowed text, with synthetic tests shaped like run 70beb28e. F19-01 recorded as answered by D-152: 19's resolver-only and host-only rows were dropped at ctbadns and cthost with zero upload usage. One assembled run, c52bea6c on 037f4418 (1,569.9 s, no other suite overlapping): 26 pass, 2 blocked, 1 fail. The shared publisher's capacity PATCH and publication PUT both returned 202 on the first attempt and serving was observed, so F19-02 is answered by devstack 32; 14 logical node writes, 14 attempts, no 412. AT10 9/0/0, AT11 2/1/0 (native platform matrix blocked), AT12 10/0/0, AT13 5/1/1. F20-01, the failure: in the short whole-node expiry, the agent installed a safety_check_failed baseline after tunnel_probe HEALTH_CHECK_FAILED, 40.99 s before the still-valid generation-33 lease's deadline, so the boundary window saw 0 positives and 202 drops; routed to agent-core with devstack, the row stays failed. D-147's native path was reached and counted (18 member accepts, four MSS clamps, six PMTU accepts). Two recording gaps of the lane's own (the operation collector, and a discarded setup publication trace) fixed offline afterwards in 4fc47dd1, since acceptance had been reached; no rerun. Zero owned Docker inventory. 5 commits, 307 owned files. Codex gpt-6-astra. | done (#442) |

| w3-wire-nodes follow-up 35 | Devstack 32's request, under the orchestrator's revised provisional ruling. Spec §14.5 and the contract give zero no special meaning, so `nodes.ParseIfMatch` now accepts `"0"` and every caller compares it as it compares any other version: a row at version 0 matches and is written, and every other row gets the ordinary 412 RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT with `details.current_resource_version`. The first session stopped at the brief's precondition, correctly: explicit inserts may store version 0 in `nodes` and `exits`, while production enrollment defaults to 1; the dated note keeps that counterexample. Integration tests on all four guarded routes (capacity PATCH, revoke POST, retire DELETE, publication PUT) prove that zero and stale non-zero conflicts return the current version with no state, operation, audit, outbox or idempotency change, and that the same key and body with the read ETag then succeed once; a zero-row test proves a matching `"0"` writes and advances to 1; standalone service entry points cover all six audited call sites. Missing or empty headers keep 428; malformed values keep today's 412, now also tested for leading zeros, weak and list tags, and overflow. No schema, contract or contract-version change. One nonblocking hand-off: devstack's publisher proof comment. 3 commits, 4 owned files. Codex gpt-6-astra. | done (#443) |

| w2-agent-core follow-up 47 | D-150's post-merge measurement of agent-core 37 to 43, fourth attempt, on the same frozen arms (A 567080be, B 38420dad). The runner implements the orchestrator's suite-program ruling: a suite is a make with AT, node-test-netlab or netlab-test arguments, a go test, or an interpreter running gates.sh, judged by argv program; an inline waiting shell is not a suite, its suite descendants are. It is tested on synthetic process tables, with bounded preflight waits inside the reservation; 32 runner tests pass. The first dry reservation was granted in 0.06 s and its preflight cleared in 4 s with no foreign activity. Dry leg A ran all 13 scenarios and passed 12: TestLabExternalMeterReset found no recovery after 12.393 s, where main's lab passes it in 1.466 s. Under the brief's rule a frozen scenario failure stops the timing item: B, the second dry reservation, the declaration and both measured windows did not run, both arms have zero pooled legs, and no comparison, B-only failure or attributable shift exists. A's dry distributions (outer guard p99 56.486 ms, maximum 67.369 ms) are kept as diagnostics only. The ordinary main lab passed 13/13 on 6548329f: expiry's last positive at −100.281 ms, first drop at −63.766 ms, no late positive; renewal 1518/1518 with zero loss. One full-module run failed R23's checkpoint-read/restart subtest on a heartbeat deadline; a targeted recheck and a full retry passed, and the failure is retained. No production change. 5 commits, 15 owned files. Codex gpt-6-astra. | done (#444) |

| w4-at-members follow-up 20 | Review r27's two members findings, offline. M-2 (AT09): the restart's timeline starts at the restart, each non-serving observation is judged by the lease it was sent under, index 25 records D-067 as blocked/not exercised when no grant-less lease follows the restart, index 26 accepts either lease sequence, and a new subcheck rejects TC_FOREIGN_FILTER after a restart with no foreign filter (it fails on run 50117c68's evidence until agent-core fixes r27 H-1). M-3 (AT02): D-135/D-136 as confirmed, applied by the orchestrator. Failed Applies link for apply_rollback and apply_quarantine; brackets close at the first verified Apply that serves the sibling; the D-136 deny-all Apply is a step inside; interface-down losses are placed by send time. 190 judges the accounting and 191 the recovery after the close. Zero loss is not the criterion. Replayed on run 2 offline as a proof, not a verdict: three brackets, 1,242 losses, all recovered. Five node writes use devstack 33's WriteNode, with receipts and an AST audit; the grant fallback is kept. Historical runs stay failed. Session on codex gpt-6-astra. | done (#445) |
